papers.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
papers.summary: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block.

papers.summary: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known.
